sources.text:
The Berlengas are a Portuguese archipelago consisting of small Atlantic islands 10 to 17 kilometres (6.2–10.6 miles; 5.4–9.2 nautical miles) off the coast of Peniche, Portugal, in the Oeste region. These islands were traditionally known to British mariners as "the Burlings". The only inhabited island is its largest island, Berlenga Grande, although there is currently no permanent habitation in the archipelago. The other islands are grouped into two groups of islets, the Estelas Islets and the Farilhões-Forcados Islets.


== History ==

Human occupation on Berlenga Grande dates back to antiquity: the islands are referred to in Ptolemy's Geography as Λονδοβρίς (Londobris). Much later it was referred to as the island of Saturno by Roman geographers, and was visited successively by Muslims, Vikings and privateers.
The islands are thought to be a former sacred place adopted by the Phoenicians in the first millennium BC where the cult of Baal–Melqart was celebrated.

stops.name: Berlengas
stops.detail: Die Berlengas sind ein portugiesisches Archipel, bestehend aus kleinen atlantischen Inseln 10 bis 17 Kilometer vor der Küste von Peniche, Portugal, in der Region Oeste. Diese Inseln waren den britischen Seeleuten traditionell als "die Burlings" bekannt. Die einzige bewohnte Insel ist die größte Insel, Berlenga Grande, obwohl es derzeit keine dauerhafte Besiedlung im Archipel gibt. Die anderen Inseln sind in zwei Gruppen von Inselchen unterteilt, die Estelas-Inseln und die Farilhões-Forcados-Inseln.
